Name: Black Diamond Apple Tree
Author: CactusWithGlasses
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Bring the beautiful and unique black diamond apple to your Stardew farm with a new fruit tree!

The sapling can be purchased from Pierre and grows in Fall, it is a much more expensive counterpart to your normal apple trees with fruit that are more valuable. Plus they're a very cool dark purple and apparently taste like honey and vanilla! (I wouldn't know, I've never gotten to try one)

I was always fascinated by these apples, I just think they're neat! And I used to use a mod called [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4513]Spoopy Valley[/url] that added them as well as a variety of other dark colored crops fit for the Halloween vibe. However, that mod hasn't been updated for 1.6 yet, and uses dependencies that are really out of date, so I decided to make this standalone inspired by it for my own farm and share it with all of you!

I am unsure if I will add unique artisan goods or cooking recipes for these apples in the future, but if inspiration strikes I will update the mod in the future!

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Install like any other Content Patcher Mod

-Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
-Install my mod's main file, extract it, and copy the '[CP] Black Diamond Apple Tree' folder to your 'Mods' folder
-Launch Stardew Valley with SMAPI [/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] [/color]

But of course, I highly recommend any mods that give you new artisan goods that use fruit!

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
A particular shoutout to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Amburr]Amburr [/url]for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4513]Spoopy Valley[/url] mod that I used to use on one of my first ever modded farms. This is not a port, remade the sprites (and mine ended up a bit more dark purple than black as I was vibing out what I liked best) myself, but if they ever port Spoopy Valley I imagine this mod will be compatible but a bit redundant.

(Reoccurring theme with my mods so far, huh?)
